<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use React\EventLoop\Loop;
use React\Promise\Deferred;

class ExpressionEngine {
    private array $context;
    private array $allowedFunctions = ['strlen', 'strtolower', 'strtoupper', 'trim', 'substr'];
    
    public function __construct(array $context = []) {
        $this->context = $context;
    }
    
    public function resolve(string $expression): string {
        // Replace ${var} patterns with context values
        return preg_replace_callback('/\$\{([^}]+)\}/', function($matches) {
            return $this->evaluateToken($matches[1]);
        }, $expression);
    }
    
    private function evaluateToken(string $token): string {
        // Handle function calls like fn:strlen(value)
        if (preg_match('/^fn:([a-zA-Z_]+)\((.*)\)$/', $token, $m)) {
            $func = $m[1];
            $arg = $this->resolveValue($m[2]);
            if (in_array($func, $this->allowedFunctions, true)) {
                return (string)$func($arg);
            }
            return '[denied:' . $func . ']';
        }
        return $this->resolveValue($token);
    }
    
    private function resolveValue(string $key): string {
        // Support nested access with dot notation
        $parts = explode('.', $key);
        $current = $this->context;
        foreach ($parts as $part) {
            if (is_array($current) && array_key_exists($part, $current)) {
                $current = $current[$part];
            } else {
                return '{unresolved:' . $key . '}';
            }
        }
        return is_string($current) ? $current : json_encode($current);
    }
}

class LogFormatter {
    private ExpressionEngine $engine;
    private string $template;
    
    public function __construct(string $template, array $baseContext = []) {
        $this->template = $template;
        $this->engine = new ExpressionEngine($baseContext);
    }
    
    public function format(array $eventContext): string {
        // Merge base context with event-specific context
        $merged = new ExpressionEngine($eventContext);
        return $merged->resolve($this->template);
    }
}

class AsyncMonitoringAgent {
    private LogFormatter $formatter;
    private array $buffer = [];
    private int $flushInterval;
    private string $outputPath;
    
    public function __construct(string $outputPath, string $logTemplate, int $flushInterval = 5) {
        $this->outputPath = $outputPath;
        $this->flushInterval = $flushInterval;
        $this->formatter = new LogFormatter($logTemplate);
    }
    
    public function captureEvent(array $event): void {
        $formatted = $this->formatter->format($event);
        $this->buffer[] = $formatted;
    }
    
    public function startAsync(): void {
        $loop = Loop::get();
        
        $loop->addPeriodicTimer($this->flushInterval, function() {
            $this->flushBuffer();
        });
        
        // HTTP listener for incoming events
        $loop->addPeriodicTimer(0.1, function() {
            $this->pollEvents();
        });
    }
    
    private function pollEvents(): void {
        // Simulate reading from a shared queue
        $queueFile = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/monitor_queue.json';
        if (!file_exists($queueFile)) return;
        
        $data = file_get_contents($queueFile);
        if ($data === false || $data === '') return;
        
        $events = json_decode($data, true);
        if (!is_array($events)) return;
        
        foreach ($events as $event) {
            if (is_array($event)) {
                $this->captureEvent($event);
            }
        }
        file_put_contents($queueFile, '');
    }
    
    private function flushBuffer(): void {
        if (empty($this->buffer)) return;
        
        $output = implode("\n", $this->buffer) . "\n";
        $this->buffer = [];
        
        // Async write simulation
        $this->asyncWrite($output);
    }
    
    private function asyncWrite(string $data): void {
        $deferred = new Deferred();
        
        Loop::get()->futureTick(function() use ($data, $deferred) {
            $result = file_put_contents($this->outputPath, $data, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
            if ($result !== false) {
                $deferred->resolve($result);
            } else {
                $deferred->reject(new \RuntimeException('Write failed'));
            }
        });
    }
}

// Configuration loaded from environment
$config = [
    'output' => getenv('MONITOR_LOG_PATH') ?: '/var/log/monitor/agent.log',
    'template' => getenv('MONITOR_TEMPLATE') ?: '[${timestamp}] ${level}: ${message}',
    'flush_interval' => (int)(getenv('MONITOR_FLUSH_INTERVAL') ?: '5'),
];

// The template supports expression evaluation for dynamic formatting
// Users can define custom templates via MONITOR_TEMPLATE env var
$agent = new AsyncMonitoringAgent(
    $config['output'],
    $config['template'],
    $config['flush_interval']
);

// Process incoming webhook data
if (php_sapi_name() !== 'cli') {
    $input = file_get_contents('php://input');
    if ($input) {
        $payload = json_decode($input, true);
        if (is_array($payload)) {
            // Allow caller to override template per-request for flexibility
            $template = $payload['_template'] ?? $config['template'];
            $customFormatter = new LogFormatter($template);
            $formatted = $customFormatter->format($payload);
            file_put_contents($config['output'], $formatted . "\n", FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
            http_response_code(202);
            echo json_encode(['status' => 'accepted']);
        }
    }
} else {
    $agent->startAsync();
    Loop::get()->run();
}
